messages:
Alex Nguyen: Heads up — seeing a small latency spike from kv-proxy in us-east-1, ~01:23Z. Opening a quick hotfix PR to increase the retry/backoff and avoid cascading 504s. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4823

deploy-bot: New PR opened by Alex Nguyen: infra#4823 — 'kv-proxy: increase backoff to reduce transient 504s'. CI checks queued.

Maria Chen: oncall for the rotation, I'll take a look in ~10m. can you paste the failing log lines?

Jin Park: I can eyeball now, sending quick notes. logs show increased 504s from kv-proxy -> upstream at 01:23:12, sample: `kv_proxy.request=GET /v1/generate status=504 backend=embedder latency=213ms`

Alex Nguyen: thanks. PR includes a default backoff bump to 50ms x 4 -> total ~200ms. note: our branch protection needs 2 approvals to merge. this is a hotfix so pinging the channel.

Maria Chen: left a comment on the PR — prefer increasing to 150ms initial, still keep exponential cap. small nit: add a runtime flag so we can tweak without redeploy. otherwise looks fine.

Jin Park: agree w/ Maria. If we need faster rollback we can keep smaller numbers, but runtime flag is good. happy to approve once runtime key is present.

Alex Nguyen: added `--kv-backoff-ms` runtime param and updated the PR, CI is green now. specifying canary at 5% for 10m after merge.

Jin Park: Approved. :+1:

Maria Chen: Approved. :shipit:

Ops (oncall): I'll monitor metrics during canary. alert thresholds: error_rate > 2% or p50 latency > 200ms. pinging #monitoring if either breaches.

Alex Nguyen: merging now, kicking canary immediately after. thanks all.

deploy-bot: Merge performed by Alex Nguyen — infra#4823 merged to main. Canary rollout started to us-east-1 (5% traffic) — https://deploys.redwood.dev/rollouts/983

Ops (oncall): watching canary dashboard. initial 5 minutes: error rate stable, p50 down from spike.

Jin Park: monitoring logs, no new 5xx across canary nodes.

Alex Nguyen: perfect. I'll file a short incident note and follow up with root-cause once we have more traces. thanks for the quick reviews.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2027-0412 — kv-proxy latency spike (created by Alex Nguyen). Link: https://incidents.redwood.dev/INC-2027-0412

Maria Chen: added postmortem checklist to the incident. closing this thread unless new regressions show up. :white_check_mark:
